  • io:I Round 0: the 451-word data preamble (deadman3d.preamble_words()) then the title screen's RLE (title_words(): one pre-encoded RUN command word per run), committing the title frame; each later round is ONE command word, a bitmask of the keys held this frame: 1=W fwd, 2=S back, 4=A left, 8=D right, 16=space FIRE; 0 renders idle, higher bits are ignored, opposing keys cancel. Turn first, then move, then render: exactly one committed frame per round, no program output. keys('wa ')==21 walks, turns and fires at once; the demo walk is WALK_CHORDS.
